ultrarare_occurrence.evidence_class: prospective preregistered species-layer support within one geography
ultrarare_occurrence.interpretation: exact observed island adjacency contains heldout presence information beyond the source-aware R3 reference

aggregate_balance_v1_122.corrected_interpretation: aggregate graph-pressure contributions are more evenly distributed among observed sources than matched random placements; this is not by itself spatial complementarity

target_space_turnover_v1_181.conclusion: distributed source-territory irreplaceability is not supported; observed source influence is more overlapping and locally less dominated than matched random placements

ecological_synthesis.core: exact source topology can contain heldout occurrence information even when the occupied sources are not unusually differentiated into unique source-influence territories
ecological_synthesis.key_nonobvious_boundary: network-level topology specificity does not imply source-level structural irreplaceability
ecological_synthesis.structural_pattern: observed ultrarare source sets combine relatively balanced aggregate contribution with greater-than-random local co-coverage and lower-than-random source-identity turnover across target islands
ecological_synthesis.mechanism_removed: the v1.119 topology signal should not be explained as a set of distinct, individually irreplaceable source territories
ecological_synthesis.mechanism_remaining: the topology signal is compatible with collective configuration or overlapping source-neighborhood structure; no causal dispersal mechanism is established

independent_temporal_boundary.interpretation: static source-network information is not validated as later demographic consequence

primary_next_step: revise GEB submission framing so topology specificity is explicitly separated from source-node irreplaceability; remove all spatial-complementarity wording derived solely from v1.122 aggregate N_eff
